resolve.armed: Press again to save it. GOTCHA will answer customers with the text above.
resolve.alreadyApproved: This was already approved, so nothing was written twice.

use.in_use: Saved. GOTCHA answers with this from now on.

problem.already_covered: Your knowledge base already answers this, so nothing was added. This suggestion is marked as covered and will not come back as a conflict.
problem.no_knowledge_base: There is no knowledge base to save this into yet. Create one first, and then this will have somewhere to go.
problem.not_found: This suggestion is no longer there. Someone may have decided it already — reload to see where it stands.
problem.forbidden: You do not have permission to change the knowledge base. Whoever administers GOTCHA for you can do this or grant it.
problem.too_long: One of these answers is too long to save as it stands. Shorten it in the knowledge base after approving a shorter one, or edit it there directly.
problem.failed: We could not save that just now, and nothing was written. Try again in a moment.
